key_insight: This review highlights how AI-assisted thermoreflectance imaging can help map nanoscale thermal properties and reveal heat transport shaped by interfaces and defects.
engineering_relevance: Improved thermal mapping could guide heat management in heterogeneous electronics, materials discovery, and advanced manufacturing.
method: Review non-contact pump–probe thermoreflectance imaging and scanning techniques.
Survey AI-assisted high-throughput processing and visualization of interfacial thermal transport.
Discuss nonintrusive subsurface analysis and future three-dimensional property mapping.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a review of recent advances but reports no quantitative datasets, benchmarks, or accuracy improvements.
watch_item: Imaging throughput must be balanced against measurement accuracy, especially when extracting multiple thermal parameters with high confidence.
paper_title: Intelligent Imaging of Thermal Transport in Nanostructures
